A first block member is positioned in the peripheral region and surrounds the display structures, with the first block member having a first height. A second block member is also disposed in the peripheral region, surrounding the first block member and spaced apart from it in a direction toward the outer portion of the peripheral region. outputs.L4:
A display device includes a substrate having a display region in which a plurality of pixels is arranged and a peripheral region positioned outside the display region. Display elements, such as organic light-emitting diodes, may be disposed in the display region together with associated driving circuitry and conductive lines. The peripheral region may include signal lines, power lines, driving circuits, and sealing structures for protecting the display elements from external moisture, oxygen, and contaminants.

A first block member is disposed in the peripheral region so as to surround at least part of the display region. A second block member is positioned farther outward from the display region than the first block member and is spaced apart from the first block member. The second block member has a greater height than the first block member relative to an upper surface of the substrate. The block members may extend continuously around the display region or may include multiple segments arranged along its perimeter. They may be formed from an organic insulating material, an inorganic insulating material, a photo-patternable resin, or a combination thereof.

A first encapsulation layer is formed over the display region and may extend toward the peripheral region. The first encapsulation layer covers the display elements and can include one or more inorganic films that inhibit penetration of moisture and oxygen. A second encapsulation layer is disposed over the first encapsulation layer and extends into the peripheral region. At least a portion of the second encapsulation layer overlaps the first block member. Depending on the design, the second encapsulation layer may terminate between the first and second block members, contact the second block member, or extend over at least part of the second block member.

Because the first block member is lower than the outwardly located second block member, the encapsulation layers form a tiered or stepped profile near the edge of the display region. The first block member can control the spreading or thickness of an encapsulating material, while the taller second block member provides an additional barrier against material overflow and environmental intrusion. The overlap between the second encapsulation layer and the first block member also lengthens the path through which moisture or oxygen would need to travel to reach the display elements. This arrangement can reduce edge defects, delamination, cracking, and degradation of the display structures.

A method of manufacturing the display device includes preparing the substrate, defining the display and peripheral regions, and forming the pixel circuits and display elements in the display region. The first block member is then formed in the peripheral region around the display region. The second block member is formed outside and apart from the first block member, with its upper surface located higher than that of the first block member. The block members may be produced in separate patterning operations or in a common operation using a multi-depth mask or different material thicknesses.

The first encapsulation layer is subsequently deposited over the display elements. The second encapsulation layer is formed over the first encapsulation layer and patterned or deposited so that it overlaps at least part of the first block member. Additional organic and inorganic encapsulation films may be included to create a multilayer barrier. The resulting structure combines the different heights and positions of the block members with overlapping encapsulation layers to improve sealing reliability and provide durable protection for the display region.
outputs.L5:
## A Display Device

A display device is an electronic component that presents information visually. It converts signals from a computer, smartphone, television, or other electronic system into images, text, and video that users can see.

Common display devices include computer monitors, televisions, smartphone screens, projectors, and digital information boards. Modern displays usually use technologies such as liquid-crystal display (LCD), light-emitting diode (LED), or organic light-emitting diode (OLED). Each technology offers different advantages in terms of image quality, brightness, energy efficiency, cost, and thickness.

Important characteristics of a display device include screen size, resolution, refresh rate, color accuracy, and response time. High resolution produces sharper images, while a high refresh rate makes movement appear smoother. Brightness and contrast also affect how clearly content can be viewed in different lighting conditions.

Display devices play an essential role in communication, education, entertainment, medicine, and industry. As technology continues to develop, displays are becoming thinner, more flexible, interactive, and energy-efficient.

counterfactuals.prompt: Describe a display device and its manufacturing method in formal patent language, emphasizing that the outer block member is taller than the inner block member.
counterfactuals.output:
A display device comprises a display panel including a display area in which a plurality of pixels is disposed, an inner block member disposed on a peripheral portion of the display panel, and an outer block member disposed outward of and adjacent to the inner block member. The inner block member has a first height measured from a reference surface of the display panel, and the outer block member has a second height measured from the reference surface, wherein the second height is greater than the first height. Accordingly, an upper surface of the outer block member is positioned above an upper surface of the inner block member. The outer block member may thereby provide enhanced lateral protection, alignment, and containment for one or more components arranged within a region bounded by the outer block member.

A method of manufacturing the display device comprises providing a display panel having a display area and a peripheral area surrounding at least a portion of the display area; forming or mounting an inner block member on the peripheral area; and forming or mounting an outer block member outward of the inner block member. The inner block member is formed to have a first height relative to a reference surface of the display panel, and the outer block member is formed to have a second height relative to the same reference surface, the second height being greater than the first height. The outer block member and the inner block member may be formed sequentially or concurrently by deposition, molding, printing, dispensing, bonding, or a combination thereof. After formation, a height difference is maintained between the outer and inner block members such that the outer block member projects farther from the display panel than the inner block member.
counterfactuals.label: cf_2

counterfactuals.prompt: Write a concise technical disclosure for an OLED display having stepped peripheral dam structures and first and second encapsulation layers.
counterfactuals.output:
An organic light-emitting diode (OLED) display includes a substrate having a display area and a peripheral area surrounding at least a portion of the display area. OLED elements are disposed in the display area. A dam structure is disposed in the peripheral area and includes a plurality of dam portions arranged at different distances from the display area. At least one dam portion has a height different from an adjacent dam portion, thereby defining a stepped profile that increases in height toward or away from the display area.

A first encapsulation layer extends over the OLED elements and at least partially across the stepped dam structure. The first encapsulation layer may include an inorganic barrier layer, an organic planarization layer, or a multilayer stack thereof. A second encapsulation layer is disposed over the first encapsulation layer and extends across one or more of the dam portions. The second encapsulation layer may terminate at a different dam portion than the first encapsulation layer. The stepped dam structure controls lateral spreading of an organic encapsulant, reduces abrupt topographic transitions, and lengthens a moisture- and oxygen-infiltration path, thereby improving edge coverage and encapsulation reliability.
counterfactuals.label: cf_3

counterfactuals.prompt: Provide an abstract for a patent application concerning moisture-protective encapsulation in a display panel using concentric block members with different heights.
counterfactuals.output: A display panel includes a substrate having a display area, an encapsulation layer covering the display area, and a plurality of block members disposed around the display area. The block members extend along respective closed paths and are concentrically arranged between the display area and an outer edge of the substrate. At least two of the block members have different heights relative to a surface of the substrate. The differing heights define a stepped peripheral structure that increases a moisture permeation path and improves adhesion and coverage of the encapsulation layer. The block members may support or engage one or more inorganic and organic encapsulation films, thereby reducing defects caused by abrupt topography and suppressing lateral ingress of moisture and oxygen into the display area. Accordingly, environmental reliability and service life of the display panel are improved.
